text:
maria: FYI hitting a weird edge in the sample-app onboarding flow.
maria: When the auth layer retries, json_mode output sometimes becomes an array-of-objects and breaks our schema validators.

sam: ugh that's new. Can you paste a minimal repro + config?

maria: repro below. It's the /generate call with retry middleware enabled and the SDK set to json_mode=true.

maria: Request (pseudocode):
```
POST /v1/generate
{ prompt: 'summary of X', json_mode: true }
```

maria: Response that fails schema validation (we expect a single object):
```
[ { "title": "short" }, { "notes": "extra" } ]
```

li: Is the retry causing the model response to be concatenated? Or is the SDK double-parsing/coercing?

ashok: My hunch: retry wrapper replays a streaming response and the SDK's json-mode helper tries to coerce each chunk separately, accumulating into an array. JS/Py parity could be the culprit if one SDK collects and the other returns the first parsed object.

emily: I saw a similar thing in CI - our schema linter flagged "expected object, got array" on the sample-app smoke tests after a flappy auth backend.

maria: Exact scenario: token refresh triggers one quick retry. Model returns complete JSON both times; helper merges them into list. Works fine when no retry.

sam: Can we add a guard in the helper: if top-level parsed value is array and array.length==2 and both are objects and one looks like a duplicate, prefer-last-object as a temporary mitigation? Dangerous but might reduce customer pain.

li: We should also add stricter streaming semantics: the retry/replay should reset the JSON buffer so the helper doesn't accumulate across attempts.

ashok: Agreed. I'll sketch a patch: 1) have retry wrappers emit a special control event "retry_start" into the stream; 2) the JSON parser listens for that event and drops partial state on receipt. That preserves correct streaming semantics without brittle heuristics.

emily: Could we also add a CLI lint rule for sample-app tests: warn or fail if json_mode enabled + retry middleware present? That would catch regressions.

maria: For immediate unblock, I disabled retry for the onboarding sample and re-ran tests — green.

qa-bot: Test run: sample-app/onboard-smoke v1.3.2 -> PASSED after disabling retry (logs: https://ci.internal/runs/5421)

sam: Long-term: ensure both SDKs have same semantics. Maria, can you capture minimal HTTP traces and attach? Also tag SDK owners @li and @ashok.

maria: attaching traces to the github issue now: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/1289

li: I'll add a unit test to the JS SDK that simulates a retry with two complete JSON chunks and ensure we either parse last or error with a clear message.

ashok: I'll mirror in Python and implement the control-event approach so parsers drop state on retry. I'll open draft PRs for both.

emily: Also let's add a short UX note in the docs: "If you enable json_mode, avoid middleware that replays streaming responses until SDKs are updated." Put that in the devex docs and sample-app README.

maria: Thanks all. Patch plan: disable retry in sample-app (done), docs note (emily), JS test + PR (li), Py PR (ashok). Followups in the GH issue.

sam: Nice coordination. :thumbsup:

maria: Closing loop when PRs are merged.
summary: json_mode + retry middleware causes accumulated arrays; plan: parser reset on retry via control event, SDK parity tests, docs note, temp disable retry in sample-app
